diagnostics.title: Nearly everyone was infected: only the depletion of susceptibles limits this epidemic

levers.rationale: Variation between people in susceptibility: the most susceptible are infected first, so the epidemic ends smaller at the same R0. A coefficient of variation of 1 is illustrative.
levers.label: Add variation between people (CV 1) and rerun

levers.rationale: A behaviour response: transmission falls by up to 50% as infections rise and recovers as they fall, which flattens the peak and removes the overshoot; the size is illustrative.
levers.label: Let people become careful as cases rise and rerun

levers.rationale: The hybrid network makes households, schools and workplaces explicit, so interventions can act on them; at the same measured R0 its final size is close to the random network's, so the switch alone does not lower it.
levers.label: Switch to the hybrid network and rerun

levers.rationale: Distancing: 30% fewer contacts for eight weeks; the size is illustrative.
levers.label: Cut contacts by 30% from day 20 for eight weeks and rerun

levers.rationale: Masks: 20% less transmission per contact for 90 days; the size is illustrative.
levers.label: Add masks (20% less transmission) from day 20 for 90 days and rerun

levers.rationale: A behaviour response: transmission falls by up to 50% as infections rise and recovers as they fall; the size is illustrative.
levers.label: Let people become careful as cases rise and rerun
